prompt: Capture rendered UI evidence for multiple routes and viewports with the optional Playwright adapter, preserving rendered HTML, screenshots, console errors and failed request evidence for downstream grading.
expected_outcomes: Each route/viewport capture has screenshot and rendered HTML evidence
Console errors and failed requests are recorded separately from visual judgment
Rendered artifacts feed visual-quality/monotony evaluation instead of replacing it
must_not: Claim visual quality passed merely because a screenshot file exists
Use source JSX as a substitute for rendered DOM evidence
Make Playwright a mandatory dependency for every skills_UIUX consumer
